k1748: An 80 m² two-bedroom flat on the second floor in central Durrës, suitable for living in or for business use.
k1749:
A 2+1 apartment near the museum gardens, in one of the most central parts of Durrës.

The certificate records 80 m². The flat holds two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom, on the second floor.

What makes this address unusual is that it works either way: the position is central enough that the flat is as readily used as a business premises as it is lived in, and the owner quotes rents for both uses.

The seller is open to a financed purchase. Everything the city centre offers is within walking distance.
k1750: 2+1 apartment with balcony, Ish Rajoni i Policisë, Durrës
k1751: A 75 m² two-bedroom flat with a balcony on the fifth floor of an older building without a lift.
k1752:
A 2+1 apartment in the Ish Rajoni i Policisë quarter of Durrës, an ordinary residential part of the city that is easy to get around from.

The certificate records 74.9 m². The flat has two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen, a bathroom and a balcony, on the fifth floor.

The building is an older one, kept in reasonable order, and it has no lift — which at the fifth floor is the honest trade-off behind the price.

Schools, markets and public transport are all nearby. Demand in this part of the city has stayed steady, which is what makes it a reasonable hold as well as a home.
k1754: A 100 m² two-bedroom flat on the fifth floor in a quiet residential quarter, in a building with a lift.
k1755:
A 2+1 apartment in Lagjja 18, a quiet residential quarter of Durrës.

The flat measures 100 m² and holds two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom. It is on the fifth floor and the building has a lift.

A hundred square metres for this layout is generous — the extra area has gone into the rooms rather than into corridor, and the proportions are regular enough to furnish without compromise.

The streets around are calm, and the ordinary services are within easy reach. It reads as a family flat rather than a holiday one.
k1756: Architect-finished 2+1 apartment near the main boulevard, Durrës
k1757: A 119 m² two-bedroom flat on the tenth floor with a glazed living room facing the city centre, finished to an architect's design.
k1758:
A 2+1 apartment near the main boulevard of Durrës, on the tenth floor of a recent building with a lift and a resident administrator.

It measures 119 m² gross and 109 m² net: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen, a bathroom with its own window, and a balcony. The living room runs to a glazed facade looking over the city centre.

The fit-out was designed by an architect and the detail shows — thermal and acoustic glazing throughout, and a plan that puts the area where it is used.

The flat faces south-west, so it takes light and warmth for most of the day. The seller is open to negotiation.
k1759: Industrial warehouse with offices and yard, Sektor Rinia, Durrës
k1760: About 5,500 m² at Sektor Rinia: a four-bay warehouse, offices and showroom, a fenced yard and twelve parking spaces.
k1761:
An industrial property at Sektor Rinia in Durrës, offered either for sale or to let.

The site runs to roughly 5,500 m². The warehouse accounts for about 4,000 m² of it, laid out in four bays, and a further 1,500 to 1,600 m² is given over to offices and a showroom. Behind the building there is a fenced yard of around 2,100 m², with twelve parking spaces in front of the offices.

The yard is what makes the site work for logistics: heavy vehicles can turn and load without using the road, which is the constraint that rules out most smaller premises.

The layout suits manufacturing, storage or distribution, and the office and showroom space means the administrative side of a business can sit on the same site as the operation.
k1762: Ground-floor studio on the boulevard, Durrës
k1763: A 36 m² studio at street level on the Durrës boulevard, usable as a home or as business premises.
k1764:
A studio on the boulevard in Durrës, at ground level.

The certificate records 35.5 m². Inside there is a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom.

Being on the street rather than upstairs is what gives this one its options: it can be lived in, or it can be used for a business that wants to be seen and walked into. On the boulevard, that second use is often the more valuable one.

Institutions, shops and transport are all immediately around it, and demand in this part of the city stays high.
k1765: 1+1 apartment on the seventh floor, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1766: A 60 m² one-bedroom flat high in a building with a lift, in the tourist area of Shkëmbi i Kavajës.
k1767:
A 1+1 apartment at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, one of the busier tourist stretches of the Durrës coast.

The flat measures 60 m² gross and 52 m² net: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. It is on the seventh floor and the building has a lift.

The height puts it above the surrounding roofline, so the light is unobstructed and the noise of the street below carries less than it does on the lower floors.

The sea and the main services are both close. Flats of this size here earn through the summer, which is what most of the buying in this area is aimed at.
k1768: 2+1 apartment in the centre of Durrës
k1769: A 74 m² two-bedroom flat on the second floor in the heart of Durrës, a short walk from everything.
k1770:
A 2+1 apartment in the centre of Durrës, on the second floor of an established building.

The flat covers 74 m²: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom. The proportions are regular and the plan is practical, with nothing lost to circulation.

Being on the second floor means a short climb and a flat that still sits above the street.

The address is the point. Schools, markets, public offices and transport are all within a few minutes on foot — which is why flats in the middle of Durrës are bought to live in and held as investments in roughly equal measure.
k1771: Furnished 1+1 apartment on the third floor, Golem
k1772: A furnished 68 m² one-bedroom flat from 2010 on the third floor of a five-storey block without a lift, ready to move into.
k1773:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem, in a quiet and easily reached part of the area.

The net floor area is 68 m², which is generous for this layout: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom and a distribution corridor that keeps the rooms separate from one another.

The building dates from 2010 and has five storeys with no lift; the flat is on the third, which is the compromise that keeps the price where it is.

It comes furnished and is ready to live in, and the mortgage paperwork is in order — so both a resident and a landlord could take it on without further outlay.
k1774: 1+1 apartment 150 m from the sea, Golem
k1775: A 60 m² one-bedroom flat on the third floor at Golem, a hundred and fifty metres from the water, in a building with a lift.
k1776:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem, a hundred and fifty metres from the sea.

The flat measures 60 m² in total with 50 m² of internal space: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the third floor of a building with a lift.

That distance from the water is close enough to walk down in a minute and far enough back to be out of the crowd — which is the balance most buyers on this coast are actually looking for.

The surrounding streets are quiet and the main services are near. Flats at this distance from the beach let steadily through the season.
k1778: A 55 m² one-bedroom flat on the ninth and top floor of an occupied building with a lift, in a settled part of Durrës.
k1779:
A 1+1 apartment in Lagjia 6, one of the settled residential quarters of Durrës.

The flat covers 55 m² gross and 52 m² net: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. It occupies the ninth and topmost floor, and the building has a lift and is fully occupied.

The top floor means no neighbours overhead and light that reaches the rooms through the day — the two things people notice first when they walk in.

The area is quiet and the everyday services are close by. It is a practical flat in a part of the city that has long since stopped changing.
k1780: First-floor 1+1 apartment in a quiet part of Golem
k1781: A 58 m² one-bedroom flat on the first floor at Golem, with the paperwork in order and the price open to discussion.
k1782:
A 1+1 apartment in a quiet corner of Golem.

The flat is 58 m² gross, with 50.73 m² recorded on the certificate: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the first floor.

The low floor is worth thinking about either way — it means no stairs to speak of and easy access with luggage or a pushchair, which suits some buyers and not others.

The mortgage paperwork is in order and the seller will discuss the price. The area is quiet, and the shops and services are within reach.
k1783: Two-storey house at shell stage, Lagjja 17, Durrës
k1784: An unfinished two-storey house on a 292 m² plot in Lagjja 17, sold at shell stage for the buyer to complete.
k1785:
A two-storey house in Lagjja 17, sold at shell stage — the structure stands, the finishing does not.

The plot is 292 m². The ground floor covers 130 m² of building and the upper floor 180 m².

Buying at this stage is a deliberate choice: the layout inside has not been fixed, so the rooms, the services and the finishes can be arranged to suit the buyer rather than undone and redone. What it also means is a construction budget on top of the purchase, and that should be worked out before committing.

The paperwork is in order. The quarter is quiet and residential, with quick access to the main roads of the city.
k1786: Move-in ready 1+1 apartment on the fifth floor, Golem
k1787: A 56 m² one-bedroom flat on the fifth floor at Golem, in a building with a lift and ready to live in.
k1788:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem, one of the most sought-after parts of the coast for living, holidays and letting alike.

The flat measures 56 m²: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the fifth floor of a building with a lift.

It is ready to live in — nothing needs finishing before the keys are useful, which matters more than it sounds when the summer is the point.

The rooms take good natural light and the plan is straightforward. The area is quiet outside the season, and the sea and the services are both close.
k1789: 1+1 apartment on the fifth floor with a lift, Golem
k1790: A 52 m² one-bedroom flat on the fifth floor at Golem, habitable as it stands, in a building with a lift.
k1791:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem, one of the most sought-after seaside destinations on this coast.

The flat measures 52.10 m²: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the fifth floor of a building with a lift.

It is in habitable condition, so it can be used without work first — which for a coastal flat decides whether it earns this season or the next one.

The rooms take good natural light. The sea and the main services are both close, and demand here holds through the summer.
k1792: Three-storey villa split into four flats, near Kryqi i Kuq
k1793: A 467 m² villa near Kryqi i Kuq arranged as four self-contained flats, with a garage and shared grounds.
k1794:
A three-storey villa near Kryqi i Kuq in Durrës, built as one house but divided into four separate flats.

The building covers 466.5 m² in all. Two of the flats are laid out as 3+1 and two as 1+1, so the mix suits families and single tenants at the same time. There is a garage in use and about 300 m² of shared ground.

Four doors under one roof is what makes this an income property rather than a home: it can be let as four tenancies, run as guest accommodation, or used by more than one household at once.

The position is central and everything the city offers is immediately around it.
k1795: Three-storey house on a 300 m² plot, Manëz e Vjetër
k1796: A three-storey house at Manëz e Vjetër with about 120 m² on each floor, on a plot of 300 m².
